page: Amazon Web Services m8ib.32xlarge is an eighth-generation general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor architecture. The instance features dedicated x86_64 Intel processors running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, providing 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory totals 512.0 GB, establishing a standard balanced general-purpose allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware connectivity includes a baseline network bandwidth of 133 Gbps, delivering high-throughput data transfer capabilities for distributed environments. The m8ib.32xlarge provides no bundled local NVMe storage, requiring all persistent and non-volatile data storage to reside on external networked storage volumes. In addition, the instance contains zero integrated graphics processing units (0.0 GPUs) and does not assign complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count, large balanced memory capacity, and substantial network interface throughput, the instance provides high compute density within a standard general-purpose tier. It is technically suited for large enterprise applications, high-traffic web backends, data transformation pipelines, large relational databases relying on remote block storage, and distributed computing nodes requiring strong network throughput without local storage dependencies.
